name: Lonely Hospital: Revelations
storyline:
After the terrifying events of the original Lonely Hospital, the abandoned hospital has become the center of a horrifying mystery. Something went terribly wrong beneath its walls and the truth was never meant to be discovered.

Return to the hospital and uncover the dark revelations hidden within its abandoned corridors and forgotten rooms. Explore carefully, solve disturbing puzzles, search for essential resources, kill terrifying zombies, and do whatever it takes to survive the nightmare.
summary: A dark third-person survival horror experience where fear, violence, and disturbing secrets await behind every door.
